Write the STAC Collection of an obis-h3 release

Source: R/export.R
obis_h3_stac_collection.Rd

Reads a release's release.json (from obis_h3_export_parquet()) and writes collection.json, a STAC Collection for the Ocean Metrics h3 profile 1.1 (platform/packages/catalog/schemas/h3.schema.json), plus one STAC Item per map layer under items/ (all and each EOV), with the hooks the atlas reads:

Usage

obis_h3_stac_collection(
  release_dir,
  file = file.path(release_dir, "collection.json"),
  id = "obis_h3",
  items = TRUE
)

Arguments

release_dir

the release directory (holding release.json).

file

output file (default collection.json in release_dir).

id

the collection id (default "obis_h3", the id the atlas's ?c=obis_h3 names).

items

write the Items under release_dir/items/ and link them (default TRUE).

Value

invisibly, the paths written (the collection, then the Items).

Details

  • h3:resolutions, h3:layout (the all layer's template, its parent splits and row_group_rows, the largest row group of a cell-sorted file), table:columns;

  • h3:periods, a list of two period sets, decades and years, each with its values, placeholder, resolutions and template;

  • h3:species_table (template, resolutions, class partitions, sort, columns with name_key, year_min, year_max and the decade variant's period, lookup, heads) and h3:heads (the heads are taxon layers);

  • cube:dimensions: layer (all and the EOVs, one Item each), indicator (the five columns), period (all, the decades as <yyy0>s, the years as <yyyy>) and res; atlas:metric (the default indicator, es);

  • item_assets (each Item's data, decade and year assets: a layer folder and the path template under it);

  • the assets stats (the legend's source: p02 to p98 per layer, key, period, res and variable), taxon_groups (the taxa and heads to search, with their paths), files, release, the species lookup, the heads list and species_flat.

Every href is relative to the release folder; obis_h3_stac_stable() makes the copy with absolute hrefs that lives at a stable url. The other layers (taxon, decade, year, species) stay listed under obis:layers and obis:species.
